purpose: A library of learning subjects in a divider grid: each subject is one framed card with its name, what it covers and a list of its article links, and an optional closing call to action spans the grid's last two cells so the grid ends without an empty cell. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'subject-library', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — so its whole API is the props below, and it composes `section-module`, `frame-box`, `card-grid`, `call-to-action` and `button` rather than owning any anatomy of its own.
useWhen: On the Learning Center index, to list every subject with the articles that teach it.
Whenever a page needs a grid of topic cards that each carry a short list of links, closed by one call to action.
avoidWhen: For a grid of features with artwork → use `feature-tiles`.
For a filterable list of rows → use `listing-browser`.
Inside another band's cell → compose `frame-box` and `call-to-action` directly.
related: call-to-action` — the `lead` band drawn in the closing cell.
card-grid` — the divider grid the subject cards sit in.
bestPractices: Give every subject a unique `slug`; it is the card's `id`, so a `#slug` link lands on it.
Keep the subject count at a multiple of three plus one when `closing` is set, so the closing cell fills the last row exactly.
Keep each subject's articles to a handful; the card grows with its list.
